notes: The three כִּי clauses are each rendered when and each aligned to its own particle.
Both אֲדֹנָי suffixes go unrepresented; the title's two the's are supplied on the construct nouns, the second being the multi-level chain's second the under rule 29.

נָשַׁמָּה → it was made desolate heads on the complement desolate under rule 44, while נִחָל → it was profaned heads on the lexical verb under rule 17.
